name: DevTac Equipment
description_html:
This mod adds two new textures, on the DevTac Ronin and Slick. Makes it possible to install night and thermal vision modules on DevTac, as well as two dynamic electromagnetic protection modules for helmet and vest.

Items available for purchase from a merchant (Mechanic):

DevTac Ronin Helmet

DevTac Headset Module

DevTac Ronin Module

DevTac Night Vision Module

DevTac Thermal Vision Module

DevTac Ronin Slick Armor

DevTac Slick Armor Module MKI

DevTac Slick Armor Module MKII

DevTac Slick Armor Module MKIII Disabled for now ( somewow is causing issues in the mod )

Is better use with Borkel’s Realistic Night Vision Goggles for better results

i eliminate the use of batteries bc im using BatterySystem that have similar use of the batteries..

if you want i can add the abillity again , but the equipments dont drain the batteries charge like in BatterySystem.

Mod installation:

Umpack DevTacEquipment.rar in /user/mods
